description: previewPaymentFees: Preview the fees that would be charged for a given payment amount. Requires authentication.

amount.description: Payment amount to preview, in the account currency as a decimal (e.g. 25.00).

sessionKey.description: Session key (osk_...) returned by checkDeviceLoginStatus. Pass it on every call when logged in via the in-chat device flow; omit when connected via OAuth.

name: previewPaymentFees
